resources.string: Choose an installed host and request a fresh on-device compatibility scan.
Select the actual installed app. Adaptation reads its code; it never forces a profile from another version or clears app data.
%1$s · Not installed for this Android user
Could not read the installed hosts. Close this dialog and retry.
No selectable host found. Install TikTok for the current Android user first.
Request saved for %1$s. In system App info, Force stop this host (do not clear its data), then open it again. Returning Home or swiping away Recents may not reload the module.

Request delivery was not confirmed. With LSPosed, check configuration sync. For an injected build, use Select host adaptation manually inside TikTok’s Toki settings; saving only in the standalone app cannot reach an injector without a configuration service.
Could not open this screen. Use the system app list instead.
Saving is not scan completion. The next full host startup bypasses old and bundled mappings and checks all known core and extension rules. Unmatched items remain visibly unsupported.
A rescan does not automatically fix changed native class or method contracts. Export a new module log if features still fail.
